head_commit.message:
fix(tui): support osc9 notifications in tmux

Wrap OSC 9 notifications with tmux's DCS passthrough when the TUI is running under tmux, and switch auto-selection to use codex-terminal-detection so the underlying client terminal decides whether OSC 9 is supported.

Validation:
- just fmt
- cargo test -p codex-tui (blocked by existing unrelated compile error in app-server/src/message_processor.rs:754)

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
